subject: Tenant slice ownership and alert clarity for console signals
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Morgan Solutions <morgan.prodlead@msol.com>, SecOps <secops@msol.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Tenant slice ownership and alert clarity for console signals

Hi team,

Following last week's customer sync with Morgan Solutions, they raised a concrete ask: their platform operations team needs a clearer mapping between console signals (cost/latency alerts) and the "tenant slice" owners that will be paged. Right now alerts land in a general channel and Morgan's on-call doesn't know whether to treat an alert as a model-routing cost spike, a tenant-config issue, or infra saturation.

Can we do two things:
- Confirm how tenant->route ownership is surfaced today in Console (what metadata exists on the alert payload).
- Propose a short-run change to routing/alerting so alerts include an explicit owner tag and an escalation path (owner, backup, and on-call).

I'm copying Morgan and their SecOps lead so we can align on what fields are needed in the alert and what cadence for changes they consider acceptable. If possible, please sketch a minimal back-compat approach so we don't break existing dashboards.

Attachments: console-alert-mapping.xlsx (xlsx) — initial mapping from the Morgan discovery session

Thanks,
Camila
Camila Reyes
Senior Product Manager, Console
Redwood Inference
From: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Morgan Solutions <morgan.prodlead@msol.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Aug 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tenant slice ownership and alert clarity for console signals

Thanks Camila — good catch. A couple quick clarifying questions before I draft an implementation proposal:

1) When you say "owner tag" do you mean a high-cardinality tenant identifier (tenant_id) plus an owner team string, or do you prefer a single owner label (eg OWNER=payments-platform)?
2) Is Morgan expecting a hard contract (SLO-based paging) or simply enriched alerts and docs so their on-call can triage faster?

Internally we currently include route_id and model_id in the alert payload, but ownership metadata is not mandatory and often missing for older customer routes. We could add owner_team and owner_contact fields to the alert proto and default to the route creator in the UI until updated.

I can sketch a low-effort change (proto + Console UI column + Alert enrichment) that would be deployable in one sprint if we limit schema changes. Markus — can you confirm whether the alerting pipeline (edge -> alert service) will accept two additional optional fields without a migration risk?

—Chloe
Chloe Martin
Product Manager, Observability
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Morgan Solutions <morgan.prodlead@msol.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Aug 2028 13:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tenant slice ownership and alert clarity for console signals

Chloe — yes, adding optional fields is fine from a pipeline perspective. A couple of notes:

- The alert proto currently allows an open key/value bag for metadata (labels), so we can push owner_team and owner_contact there without touching the main schema. That keeps it backward compatible.
- The trick is ownership completeness. For older tenant routes the label is blank. I recommend a pragmatic handoff: new routes require owner metadata on creation; for existing routes we run a one-week owner-clear-out where product managers confirm owners via a simple CSV import.

Proposed short-run:
1) Add owner_team and owner_contact labels to alerts (optional).
2) Console: show an "Owner" column on route table and surface owner in alert flyouts.
3) Pager rule: if owner_contact exists, page owner -> oncall@owner_team; else fallback to regional infra on-call.

I'll prepare the change list for infra + alert-service + console and estimate effort (I expect ~2 backend engineers, 1 frontend for 2 sprints including QA).

Markus
Markus Klein
Engineering Manager, Observability Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Morgan Solutions <morgan.prodlead@msol.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Aug 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tenant slice ownership and alert clarity for console signals

Camila / team — thanks for the quick responses. SecOps' ask is practical: enriched alerts with a reliable owner contact reduce mean time to acknowledge by a lot. We prefer owner_contact (email) + owner_role (eg "Platform Ops") over a generic owner_team label. That said, owner_team is useful for routing to the right rotation.

Attached is our suggested minimal schema (see console-alert-mapping.xlsx). For urgency: if you can roll out enrichment to a small subset of routes (our prod tenant + two staging tenants) within 3 weeks, we can validate and provide feedback.

We can also accept a compatibility approach where owner_contact is optional during rollout and auto-filled from a CSV you provide.

—Morgan Patel
Product Lead, Morgan Solutions
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: Morgan Solutions <morgan.prodlead@msol.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Aug 2028 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tenant slice ownership and alert clarity for console signals — next steps

Great progress everyone — summary and next steps: 

1) Schema: implement owner_team, owner_contact, owner_role as optional labels on alerts (Markus to own infra changes). Deliverable: PR to alert-service and proto changes by 2028-08-23.
2) Console: add Owner column and surface owner metadata in alert flyouts (Chloe to scope). Deliverable: feature branch + UX mock by 2028-08-18.
3) Backfill plan: product will validate owners for existing routes. Camila to coordinate with tenant/product owners and provide a CSV by 2028-08-16.
4) Pilot: deploy enrichment for Morgan Solutions' prod+2 staging tenants. Rollout window: 2028-08-24 to 2028-08-31. Morgan will validate and share metrics on mean time to acknowledge.

Action items assigned:
- Camila: collect owner CSV, coordinate pilot dates with Morgan (due 2028-08-16).
- Chloe: scope Console UI changes and provide mock (due 2028-08-18).
- Markus: PR for alert-service (due 2028-08-23).
- Morgan: confirm pilot tenants and provide feedback during pilot (ongoing).

I'll open JIRA-RED-1452 to track infra + console work and share the doc link. If there are any blockers (security, paging rules), flag them in the ticket so we can escalate.

Thanks,
Camila
Camila Reyes
Senior Product Manager, Console
Redwood Inference
